content: A burning sensation may occur. Cramping pain can be experienced. Rectal irritation is a potential side effect. Tenesmus, or the sensation of incomplete bowel evacuation, may develop. Severe gastrointestinal obstruction or impaction can occur in some cases. This product should not be used if abdominal pain, nausea, or vomiting are present unless specifically directed by a physician. Frequent or prolonged use of laxatives may lead to dependency. Rectal bleeding or failure to have a bowel movement after use requires immediate medical attention. If there is a sudden change in bowel habits lasting more than two weeks, consult a physician before using this product. Do not use this product for longer than one week. If constipation persists after one week of use, contact your physician. If no bowel movement occurs within one hour of using this product, seek medical advice. Keep this product out of the reach of children. If accidentally swallowed, seek medical help or contact a poison control center immediately. There is no available data on the safety of this product during pregnancy. The compatibility of this product with breastfeeding is unknown but is likely acceptable. Pregnant or breastfeeding individuals should consult a healthcare professional before using over-the-counter medications. Pregnancy Category A: Generally considered safe. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. This product acts as a hyperosmotic dehydrating agent, drawing fluid into the colon, increasing osmotic pressure, and stimulating bowel evacuation. The onset of action is typically 15 to 30 minutes. This product is poorly absorbed systemically. It is intended for rectal use only. Insert one suppository well into the rectum and retain it for 15 minutes. It does not need to melt completely to produce a laxative effect. Do not exceed one suppository per day unless directed by a physician. For children aged 2 to less than 6 years, use child-specific suppositories. For children under 2 years of age, consult a physician before use.
